concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingestion from 'PubChem or SDBS', but Task T008 hardcodes 'zjunlp/UV-Vis-ML'. No task exists to fetch from the canonical sources specified in the spec.
Plan.md Constitution Check (Principle II) mandates a 'verify-accuracy-gate' task to run Reference-Validator logic. No corresponding task exists in tasks.md to execute this gate before ingestion.

SC-001 requires a 95% confidence interval and Wilcoxon test. Task T016 implements the test and binary status but lacks a specific task to calculate and report the confidence interval required by the success criterion.

SC-004 requires a 'sensitivity analysis report' showing error rate variation. Task T026 performs the sweep but no task exists to generate the final report artifact (e.g., plot or summary table) required to satisfy SC-004.
SC-002 requires measuring wall-clock time against a 6-hour limit. Task T015 implements training but no task exists to explicitly measure, log, and verify the total pipeline execution time.

FR-002 requires ensuring 'no scaffold appears in more than one split'. Task T010 generates indices, but no explicit task is defined to programmatically verify and enforce this constraint before the merge step (T010.5), risking silent leakage.

Task T024 is described as 'consuming masked attribution from T025', but T025 is the task that 'applies' the mask to attribution weights. This creates a circular dependency (T024 needs T025's output, but T025 needs T024's output) or a reversed execution order not reflected in the task list.
